patch_description:
Add a tie-robust routing signal without replacing the existing equal-split proxy. Reuse each shortlisted network’s shortest-path distances to route three scenarios: equal splitting and two complementary, demand-oriented 75/25 splits at shortest-path ties. These scenarios are deterministic and do not depend on node numbering.

Append the upper-quartile peak load and worst scenario’s top-link average to the online predictor. Reserve one batch position for this robust ranking, preserving the existing energy, learned-quality, original-routing, novelty, and random selections. All three routings share a batched propagation pass and require no additional LP calls.
